title: 第13章 你们青云宗的面子值几个钱第14章 谁告诉你我不是武者
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
“诸位，这柄断剑可不简单，别看它有残缺，它可是削铁如泥，甚至连宗师强者的真气护罩都能破开！”
拍卖台上，雅妃玉手轻握那柄漆黑的断剑，红唇微启，声音带着一股魔力。
“什么？破宗师的护罩？”
“开什么玩笑！
宗师强者真气护体，刀枪不入，一把破剑……”
现场顿时炸开了锅，质疑声四起。
武道一途，踏入先天便可真气外放，而宗师之境，更是能凝真气为护罩，固若金汤！
除非是同级强者以命相搏，或是更强者出手，否则根本难以撼动。
雅妃微微一笑，也不多言，只是挥了挥手。
一名气息深沉的中年男人走上台，他对着众人一抱拳，随即神色一凛，体内真气轰然爆发，一道凝实的真气护罩瞬间笼罩全身。
“是烟雨阁的供奉，货真价实的宗师强者！”
有人认出了他，场内瞬间安静下来，所有人都屏住了呼吸。
只见雅妃握着断剑，姿态随意地朝着那真气护罩轻轻一劈。
没有惊天动地的巨响，只有一声清脆的“咔嚓”
声。
那坚不可摧的真气护罩，竟如脆弱的琉璃一般，自剑锋所指之处，裂开一道蛛网般的缝隙，而后轰然破碎！
嘶！
整个拍卖会场，顿时响起一阵倒吸凉气的声音。
那位宗师供奉更是踉跄着后退两步，脸色发白，看向那柄断剑的眼神写满了惊骇。
一瞬间，在场所有武者的呼吸都变得粗重起来，一道道炙热贪婪的目光，死死地钉在了那柄断剑之上。

能破开宗师护罩，这代表着什么？
代表着先天境武者，都有了威胁甚至斩杀宗师的可能！
这已经不是神兵利器，而是逆天凶器！
“这玩意……”
楚风眼底也闪过一抹讶异。
“此剑内部蕴含着一道极其恐怖的杀戮剑意，只是被封印了，我能感觉到那股让我都有些心悸的气息。”
妖姬的声音在他脑海中响起，带着一丝罕见的凝重。
而能让妖姬都说出“心悸”
二字，倒是让楚风对于此剑充满了期待。
“好了，诸位，演示完毕，此剑起拍价，一百万两！”
雅妃的话音刚落。
“一百五十万两！”
“我出两百万！”
“三百万！”
价格如同疯了一般向上狂飙，转眼间就冲破了六百万两的大关，而且势头丝毫未减。
就在这时，一道傲慢的声音响起。
“我沈国公府，出价一千万两！”
沈玉风站起身来，目光扫视全场，言语中的高傲不加掩饰。
沈国公府四个字一出，如同泼下了一盆冷水，原本喧嚣的会场瞬间寂静下来，那些还在叫价的人纷纷闭上了嘴。
谁敢和沈国公府抢东西？

那不是找死么！
content_en:
"Everyone, this broken sword is not simple. Regardless of its imperfections, it can cut iron like clay. It can even break through the true energy shield of a strong master!"
On the auction stage, Yafei's jade hand gently held the black broken sword, her red lips were slightly opened, and her voice was filled with magic.
"What? Breaking the Grandmaster's shield?"
"What a joke!
The strong master's true energy protects the body, making him invulnerable to a broken sword..."
The scene immediately exploded, and doubts arose.
In the martial arts, when you step into the innate realm, you can release your true energy, and in the realm of a master, you can even condense your true energy into a protective shield, which is as solid as gold!
Unless someone of the same level puts their lives in a fight, or someone stronger takes action, it will be difficult to shake.
Ya Fei smiled slightly and didn't say much, just waved her hand.
A middle-aged man with a deep breath walked onto the stage. He cupped his fists at everyone, and then his expression became stern. The true energy in his body exploded, and a solid protective shield of true energy instantly enveloped his body.
"He is a tribute from Yanyu Pavilion, a genuine master!"
Someone recognized him, and the place fell silent instantly, and everyone held their breath.
I saw Ya Fei holding the broken sword, casually slashing towards the zhenqi shield.
There was no earth-shattering noise, just a crisp "click"
sound.
The indestructible shield of true energy was like fragile glass. Wherever the sword pointed, a spiderweb-like gap opened, and then shattered!
hiss!
The entire auction venue suddenly heard a gasp of air.
The grandmaster staggered back two steps, his face turned pale, and his eyes were full of horror as he looked at the broken sword.
In an instant, the breathing of all the warriors present became heavy, and their hot and greedy eyes were fixed on the broken sword.
What does it mean to be able to break through the Grandmaster's shield?
It means that Xiantian realm warriors have the possibility to threaten or even kill the master!
This is no longer a magical weapon, but a heaven-defying weapon!
"This thing..."
Chu Feng's eyes also flashed with surprise.
"This sword contains an extremely terrifying murderous sword intent, but it is sealed. I can feel the aura that makes me feel a little bit palpitated."
The enchantress's voice sounded in his mind, with a rare solemnity.
And it can make the enchantress say "heart palpitations"
These two words made Chu Feng full of expectations for this sword.
"Okay, everyone, the demonstration is over. The starting price of this sword is one million taels!"
Yafei's words had just finished.
"One and a half million taels!"
"I'll pay two million!"
"Three million!"
The price soared upwards like crazy, breaking through the 6 million tael mark in the blink of an eye, and the momentum has not slowed down at all.
At this moment, an arrogant voice sounded.
"I, Shen Guogong's Mansion, bid ten million taels!"
Shen Yufeng stood up and scanned the audience, his arrogance undisguised in his words.
As soon as the words "Shen Guogong's Mansion" came out, it was like a basin of cold water was poured on it. The originally noisy venue fell silent instantly, and those who were still bidding closed their mouths.
Who dares to steal things from Shen Guogong's mansion?
Isn’t that seeking death?
